observed_in: Magic and Spellcasting System design analysis

definition: This dimension controls the variety and uniqueness of spells available to players, varying from a limited set of basic spells to a vast array of complex and unique spell options. It influences how spells interact with each other and the world, affecting player strategies and choices.
exclusion_criteria: A single spell type with no variations
inclusion_criteria: Variety of spell types (e.g., offensive, defensive, utility)
Unique spell mechanics (e.g., combination effects, environmental interactions)
title: Spell Diversity in Magic Systems
